description:
🚀 Join Zero-G Cadets!
We're building the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer—a game where players survive on the Moon/Mars by managing life support, power, and food.

As an Environmental Engineer, I'm the "Chief Scientist" making the survival rules scientifically real.

We need:
• Game Devs (Unity/WebGL/Python)
• UI/UX Designers

You bring the code/art, I bring the science! Let's build!
